messages:
emma: Kicking off a smaller-scope reorg: moving guides/* -> platform-guides/* but split into 4 PRs to keep previews sane. Goal: avoid any broken anchors in prod. Merge window Friday 11:00-12:00 PST.

emma: PRs (short):
- PR #4301 add site-level redirect + update base nav https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301 (preview: https://deploy-preview-4301--docs.redwood.com)
- PR #4302 move guides/auth/* -> platform-guides/auth and update local links https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302
- PR #4305 move guides/serving/* -> platform-guides/serving, includes SDK snippet updates https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4305
- PR #4310 anchor and cross-link fixes, plus tests https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4310

emma: Important: 4301 must land first or Netlify previews for later PRs will 404 on relocated paths. Suggest merge order: 4301 -> 4302 -> 4305 -> 4310.

rafael: I can review 4302 and 4310. I'll focus on link rewrites and anchor deltas.

celia: Heads-up: marketing pages have absolute links to `/guides/` in a few places (pricing, integrations). I'll add a short sed patch in 4301 to rewrite those to the redirect targets and leave a comment for product marketing to double-check.

tom: CI note: our linkcheck job runs on previews but will 404 for moved files until redirect exists. +1 to merging 4301 first. Also: I want a 10m wait after 4301 so CDN and previews warm.

ci-bot: queued: linkcheck for PR #4301 (deploy-preview-4301). ETA ~3m.

brandon: There's one hairy anchor: `#installation-quickstart` in guides/serving/setup.md is now `#quickstart-installation` after the move. I propose adding a small anchor mapping file `docs/anchor-mappings.csv` in 4310 so we can assert old->new anchor names in tests.

maya: I'll act as docs lead during the window. Require 1 reviewer + docs lead approve before merging. Also please disable auto-merge on all 4 PRs; we'll merge manually during the window.

emma: Merge checklist (operational):
- [ ] reviewers approve PRs
- [ ] merge 4301 (redirects + marketing sed patch)
- [ ] wait 10m for previews/CDN to reflect changes
- [ ] run `./scripts/linkcheck.sh https://staging.docs.redwood.com` (CI will do this automatically via staging-full-check)
- [ ] merge 4302, wait 5m, run linkcheck
- [ ] merge 4305, wait 5m, run linkcheck + run SDK sample smoke tests (node 18)
- [ ] merge 4310, run full anchor assertions, close anchor-mapping issue
- [ ] post short announcement to #general with common old->new paths

qa-bot: I'll run smoke tests after each merge and post results here. Tests: main nav, search, 3 anchor jumps in serving, run one SDK snippet via `node examples/snippet.js`.

celia: I'll create DOCS-512 to track any remaining absolute links and cross-repo references.

tom: Ops: I'll open DOCOPS-820 for CDN no-cache toggle for Friday 10:50-12:10 PST. We toggle to `Cache-Control: no-cache` during the window and revert 10m after.

ci-bot: DOCOPS-820 created. Also added `staging-full-check` job to the docs pipeline; it will run automatically post-merge and report failures back to the PR.

brandon: One more SDK gotcha: a sample in serving references `client.predict()` which we deprecated. I'll include a brief compatibility note in 4305 and a patch to use `client.generate()` where safe.

rafael: ack 4302 + 4310. Will try to get reviews in before tomorrow morning.

brandon: ack 4305.

celia: ack 4301 (will monitor marketing links).

emma: thanks all. I'll disable auto-merge and then ping this thread once 4301 is green so we can start the window. Please drop approvals on your assigned PRs. :rocket:
